verdict.rationale: Runloop's trial docs state that new accounts start on a Pro Trial with $50 in free credits and no credit card required. A quickstart gets a developer to a first devbox in about a minute, which indicates self-serve onboarding without contacting sales. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the self-serve signup and credit grant, and documentation of trial limits or what happens after credits run out.
